items.claim: Clear filled state when an empty control mounts
items.consequence: When a filled controlled control is replaced by a new control with an empty value under the same Field.Root, the field remains marked filled even though its input is empty. The mount effect only sets filled for a nonempty DOM value, and useValueChanged does not run for the new control's initial value. Setting filled from the actual input value on mount also clears the stale state.
items.proposed_fix: Initialize filled on each control mount to whether its current DOM value is nonempty, including explicitly setting false for an empty value.

native_fields.validation_reason: When a filled control is replaced by an empty controlled control under the same Field.Root, FieldRoot.tsx:52 retains filled state, FieldControl.tsx:99-103 only sets it for a nonempty input, and useValueChanged.ts:7-12 skips the initial value; the removed base-version effect explicitly cleared an empty controlled value, and incidence was not measured.

items.claim: Preserve cancellation when syncing controlled changes
items.consequence: A controlled field can clear a server error and run validation after its change event was canceled or default-prevented. If the callback updates the controlled value and cancels the event, the event handler returns before checking cancellation and the subsequent value effect always clears errors and validates. Carry the event cancellation through to the corresponding controlled update so those side effects remain suppressed while independent programmatic updates still synchronize.
items.proposed_fix: Track whether the controlled value update came from a prevented or canceled input event, and suppress error clearing and validation for that update; add controlled cases for both cancellation mechanisms.
